title: ALMA observations of massive molecular gas reservoirs in dusty early-type galaxies
question: Where are the dust and molecular gas located, and how are they related, in five dusty H-ATLAS early-type galaxies at z~0.04?

data.sensitivity: Aimed ±0.03 mJy continuum, ±3 mJy in CO line

what.value: Dust masses from MAGPHYS fits (GAMA DR3 MagPhys v06 catalogue) and SFRs

evidence.quote: based on multiwavebands fits using MAGPHYS (from GAMA Data Release 3, MagPhys v06 catalogue
stellar masses are from the GAMA survey (Taylor et al. 2011)
The CO intensity ratio between transitions is assumed to be r$_{21}$=CO(2-1)/CO(1-0)$\sim 1.0 \pm 0.5$ (from Young et al. 2011)

what.value: Best-fit single modified blackbody temperatures used for SED extrapolation

evidence.quote: correspond to the best fitting single modified black body temperature from Agius et al. (2013)

recipe.method: Standard calibration scripts, CASA cleaning with natural weighting; continuum subtracted using uvcontsub; manual cleaning of cubes

recipe.goal: Make CO moment maps and spectra
recipe.method: Masked-moment technique with smoothed cube and threshold at 1.5 times rms

recipe.goal: Measure CO fluxes and continuum fluxes/upper limits
recipe.method: Aperture photometry with aperture incremented until no additional flux; continuum 3sigma upper limit = 3 x sqrt(Nbeams) x Noise_rms
assumptions: 6 percent flux calibration error added in quadrature

recipe.goal: Derive molecular gas masses and gas-to-dust ratios
recipe.method: L_CO from Solomon & vanden Bout eq. 3; M_mol = 1.36 alpha_co L21 / r21; compared to MAGPHYS dust masses
assumptions: r21=1.0±0.5; XCO=3e20 (alpha_co=4.8); factor 1.36 for helium; optically thin molecular gas

recipe.goal: Compare ALMA continuum to H-ATLAS SED extrapolation
recipe.method: Modified blackbody with beta=2 fixed, normalised to H-ATLAS 250 micron flux, extrapolated to 1.3 mm
assumptions: Dust may follow molecular gas distribution; Sersic index 1 for surface-brightness test

answer_key.quantity: Mean M_mol/M_d of three CO-disk ETGs

evidence.quote: the molecular gas-to-dust mass ratios are on average M$_{mol}$/M$_d$=124 (from Table 3)

answer_key.quantity: Fraction of H-ATLAS flux possibly from offset source near GAMA177186

evidence.quote: we estimate that this offset source may have contributed $\sim$80 percent of the H-ATLAS flux

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges used for uvcontsub
Clean threshold, iteration count, and the smoothing/threshold for the masked-moment maps
Exact moment-map rms values for CO cubes
Details of the tapering test for GAMA64646
Which continuum SED data points and fit parameters in Figure 6
score_reason: Single known project and clear mass equations, but imaging parameters and by-eye aperture choices are loosely specified.
rediscovery_reason: Single project, tabulated fluxes and masses, with a simple recipe, though some imaging details are missing.
